about.title: Seal Beach Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Seal Beach saw 3 traffic deaths among its reported collisions in the most recent final crash year, alongside 88 injury crashes affecting 123 people. Behind each number is a family left to sort through funeral arrangements, financial strain, and grief, often while also trying to understand what their legal options are. California law lets certain surviving family members, starting with a spouse, domestic partner, or children, bring a wrongful death claim to recover funeral and burial costs, the financial support the deceased would have provided, and the loss of that person's love, companionship, and guidance. This is a civil matter, entirely separate from any criminal charges that might result from the crash. Corridors like I-405 and Rt 1 see steady traffic volume, and Saturday evenings between 5 and 7 p.m. show more reported collisions than other times. LawProactive helps Seal Beach families connect, free of charge, with an independent attorney who can explain these rights and next steps.
